lieu: courtyard of a family compound in Anyama near Abidjan during a traditional dowry ceremony, elders on plastic chairs under a mango tree, bottles of gin and folded wax cloths on a mat

persos.nom: the bride's father with the kente
persos.desc: proud bride's father in his 60s, kente cloth draped over one shoulder, walking stick, gold rings
persos.pose: sitting on a big chair like a king, raising one finger

persos.nom: the suitor in the cream suit
persos.desc: slim suitor in his 20s, cream suit, red bow tie, folder of papers on his knees
persos.pose: kneeling politely on the mat, one eyebrow raised

persos.nom: the bride peeking from the door
persos.desc: bride in her 20s, elegant orange-and-gold wax dress with matching headwrap
persos.pose: peeking from behind a door in the background, smiling proudly

dialogue: Ma fille a fait l'université. La dot : cinq millions.
Elle a eu le diplôme ?
…Trois millions.
Elle sait cuisiner ?
Prends-la gratuitement, mon fils !
jeu: The father announces the price proudly. The suitor asks calmly; the father coughs and lowers the price. At the second question the father panics and waves the price away with both hands.
chute: The bride, peeking from the door, drops her jaw in outrage while her father eagerly waves her toward the suitor. End on a close-up of the bride's outraged face staring into the camera.

lieu: terrace of a busy maquis in Yopougon, Abidjan, plastic table with a big plate of braised chicken and attieke, string lights, evening

persos.desc: big jovial man in his 30s, tight yellow polo shirt, eating a huge braised chicken with his hands
persos.pose: pointing a chicken leg at his friend, amazed

persos.desc: extremely thin man in his 30s, huge oversized white shirt hanging on him like a tent, belt tied very tight
persos.pose: sitting proudly, adjusting his oversized shirt

dialogue: Mon vieux, tu as maigri dêh ! C'est le sport ?
Non. C'est la fin du mois… depuis trois mois.
jeu: The big friend is amazed. The thin friend answers proudly while staring hungrily at the chicken.
chute: The big friend slowly pulls his plate of chicken back and hides it under the table, avoiding eye contact. End on a close-up of the thin friend staring into the camera with a deadpan face.

lieu: boss's office in the Plateau business district of Abidjan, big wooden desk, leather chair, window with skyscrapers

persos.nom: the employee in the blue shirt
persos.desc: confident employee in his 30s, light-blue shirt, tie, folder under his arm
persos.pose: standing in front of the desk, chest out, confident

persos.nom: the boss in the grey suit
persos.desc: boss in his 50s, grey suit, big belly, reading glasses
persos.pose: leaning back in his leather chair, skeptical

dialogue: Patron, augmentez-moi. Trois entreprises me cherchent !
Lesquelles ?
La CIE, la SODECI et mon propriétaire.
Assieds-toi. Ils me cherchent aussi.
jeu: The employee speaks proudly. The boss raises an eyebrow. The employee lists them on his fingers. The boss sighs and points at the chair.
chute: The boss pulls his own thick pile of unpaid bills out of the drawer and drops it on the desk. End on a close-up of the employee's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room in Yopougon, Abidjan, evening, old sofa, TV on, family photos on the wall

persos.nom: the little girl with the braids
persos.desc: curious little girl around 9, braids with colorful beads, yellow t-shirt
persos.pose: sitting next to her mother, asking innocently

persos.nom: the mother in the purple wax dress
persos.desc: plump mother in her 40s, purple wax dress and headwrap
persos.pose: looking at her sleeping husband with a long sigh

persos.desc: bald father in his 50s, big round belly, white singlet, asleep on the sofa with the TV remote on his belly, mouth open
persos.pose: snoring on the other end of the sofa

dialogue: Maman, pourquoi tu as épousé papa ?
À l'époque, il avait des cheveux et un salaire.
Et toi, tu avais la taille fine.
jeu: The girl asks innocently. The mother sighs, looking at her snoring husband. The father answers without opening his eyes, then keeps snoring.
chute: The mother slowly turns toward the father with murderous eyes while the girl quietly slides off the sofa. End on a close-up of the little girl looking into the camera with an 'oh no' face.

lieu: dusty street in front of a family house in Abobo, Abidjan, afternoon, a kiosk and parked motorbikes

persos.nom: the little boy with the big ears
persos.desc: little boy around 8, very big ears, big gap between his front teeth, round face, red t-shirt
persos.pose: looking up at his father, worried

persos.nom: the skinny father with tiny ears
persos.desc: very skinny tall father in his 40s, long thin face, tiny ears, perfect teeth, beige shirt

persos.nom: the neighbor with the big ears
persos.desc: chubby neighbor in his 40s with exactly the same face as the boy: very big ears, big gap between his front teeth, round face, red shirt
persos.pose: walking past in the background, waving

dialogue: Papa, à l'école ils disent que je ne te ressemble pas.
Jaloux ! Tu es mon portrait craché !
Bonjour, fiston !
jeu: The boy speaks sadly. The father answers proudly and hugs him. The neighbor waves cheerfully as he walks past.
chute: The father slowly turns his head to the neighbor, then back to the boy, comparing their identical big ears and gap teeth. End on a close-up of the father's devastated face staring into the camera.

lieu: bedroom at night in Koumassi, Abidjan, double bed with a colorful bedspread, moonlight through the window, door half-open to a dark living room

persos.desc: scrawny husband in his 30s, striped pyjamas, holding a wooden broom like a weapon
persos.pose: standing on the bed flexing his thin arms, boasting

persos.desc: wife in her 30s, pink nightgown, hair in a satin bonnet, holding the blanket
persos.pose: sitting up in bed, listening, worried

dialogue: Un voleur qui rentre ici, je le corrige !
Chéri… il y a quelqu'un au salon.
Dis-lui que je ne suis pas là.
jeu: The husband boasts and swings the broom. The wife whispers, pointing at the dark door. The husband instantly dives under the bed and answers in a tiny voice.
chute: Only the husband's trembling eyes are visible under the bed while the broom rolls out by itself. End on a close-up of the wife's unimpressed face staring into the camera.

lieu: inside an orange Abidjan taxi stuck in a gigantic traffic jam on a bridge over the Ebrie lagoon, cars everywhere, hot afternoon

persos.desc: relaxed taxi driver in his 40s, cap, toothpick in his mouth, hands on the wheel

persos.nom: the passenger with the giant beard
persos.desc: passenger in the front seat with an absurdly long white beard reaching his knees, office suit, briefcase
young woman in the back seat, green wax dress, holding a newborn baby

dialogue: On arrive bientôt, Tonton. C'est juste le pont.
Quand je suis monté, je n'avais pas de barbe !
Et moi, je n'étais même pas enceinte !
jeu: The driver reassures calmly. The passenger shows his giant beard. The woman in the back seat lifts her baby angrily.
chute: The driver honks once, the car moves forward a few centimeters and stops again. End on a close-up of the bearded passenger's desperate face staring into the camera.
